Hi Alicia — great to hear you're moving forward. I've started a short MAP and looped in Neha from our infra/onboarding team for the technical specifics. High-level answers up-front:

- We can issue scoped API keys for the POC within 24 hours of account validation. Keys are single-model scoped by default; we can provide team-level tokens if you prefer.
- IP allowlist: we support both static outbound IP ranges for hosted runs and VPC peering. For hosted IP allowlist we provide a small set of /28 ranges; if you need exact CIDRs we'll attach them.
- VPC peering: we offer peering for Dedicated or Private MAPs; typical provisioning lead time is 3-5 business days from when we exchange VPC IDs and route tables.
- Ephemeral rotation: we recommend using short-lived tokens (12h) for automated ingestion; we can provide a rotation script or short-term creds for the POC.

I'll attach a draft MAP (owners + timeline). Neha — would you confirm the exact CIDRs we can offer and any extra steps for peering? Grace from Customer Success is copied for cadence alignment.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Grace — technical details for CardioGen POC below. These are the items I recommend we include in the MAP as deliverables with owners/dates.

1) Hosted IP allowlist (fast path)
   - CIDRs available: 34.210.12.0/28, 34.210.12.16/28 (two /28s for redundancy)
   - TTL: static for the duration of POC; update window 24h notice for maintenance
   - Owner: neha_kapoor (Redwood) — provide final CIDRs within 4 hours of MAP sign-off

2) API key provisioning
   - Scoped keys per environment: ingestion-key, query-key. Can create team-scoped token if requested.
   - Rotation: we can issue a rotating key pair (recommend 12h TTL) with a simple webhook-based rotation; provide sample script in the MAP notes.
   - Owner: vanessa_ortiz (sales) to collect admin contacts; neha_kapoor to issue keys within 24h of account verification

3) VPC peering (optional path)
   - Requirements: CardioGen VPC ID, desired route table entries, allowed port list (443 for TLS + optional 10250 for diagnostics).
   - Lead time: 72–120 hours after exchange of VPC info and completed peering security review.
   - Owner: CardioGen network lead (external) to provide VPC ID; neha_kapoor to coordinate peering and firewall verification.

4) Onboarding checklist (org setup)
   - Actions: create org, invite admin users, set role mappings (admin/dev/observer).
   - Owner: vanessa_ortiz to confirm org owners; grace_oconnor will run the kickoff session and send SSO docs if required.

5) Deliverables and dates (proposal)
   - MAP sign-off (mutual): 2026-09-02
   - Hosted CIDRs delivered: 2026-09-02T12:00:00Z
   - API keys provisioned: 2026-09-03T12:00:00Z
   - Optional VPC peering complete (if requested): target 2026-09-08

I'll draft the short MAP table and sample allowlist template for them to confirm.

—Neha
